data.title: Fidelity says Bitcoin can appreciate without taking market share from gold
data.description: Fidelity Digital Assets wants to settle a debate that has consumed crypto and macro Twitter for years: does Bitcoin need to eat gold's lunch to go up in price? The answer, according to the firm's VP of Research Chris Kuiper, is a clean no.In an updated report titled "Getting Off Zero" for 2026, Fid…
